description_en: Retrieves statistics for metadata in a dataset
description_zh: 获取数据集下元数据的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace get-dataset-file-metas-statistics --dataset-id d-rbvg5wz0000c9ks92 --dataset-version v1 --workspace-id 145883 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDatasetFileMetasStatistics

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For more information about how to obtain a dataset ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the dataset version
parameters.name: dataset_version

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The metadata field used for statistical aggregation. The value is not case-sensitive. If you do not specify this parameter, the total number of file metadata entries in the dataset is returned, and the aggregation list is not returned.
Valid values:

filedir: The directory path of the file.

filetype: The file type.

tags.user: Custom user tags.

tags.user-delete-ai-tags: Algorithm tags deleted by the user.

tags.ai: Algorithm tags that are aggregated from all labeling tasks.

tags.all: A combination of algorithm tags and custom user tags, excluding any algorithm tags deleted by the user
parameters.help_zh:
按照指定的元数据字段来做统计聚合。不区分大小写。若不指定则为获取数据集文件元数据总数量，不会返回聚合列表。
支持：
filedir：文件的目录路径
filetype：文件类型
tags.user: 用户自定义标签
tags.user-delete-ai-tags: 用户删除的算法标签
tags.ai：算法标签（所有打标任务聚合后的）
tags.all: 算法标签+用户自定义标签（ 已经去除用户删除的算法标签）
parameters.name: aggregate_by

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return for each query that uses the NextToken parameter. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

DatasetFileMetasStats.description_en: The details of the returned aggregation list. You can get the count for each aggregated item. The list is sorted by Count in descending order by default
DatasetFileMetasStats.description_zh: 返回的聚合列表详情。可以获得每个聚合项的数量。列表默认按照Count DESC排序

items.description_en: The aggregated item and its count

TotalCount.description_en: The number of statistical results returned. For example, the number of metadata entries or the number of user tags
TotalCount.description_zh: 返回统计结果数量。例如：统计有多少条元数据、有多少个用户标签
